Add the `tmr-behaviors` skill (`.agents/skills/tmr-behaviors/SKILL.md`): a runbook for running `mngr tmr-behaviors` on a behavior corpus, crystallized from the first two real runs (mngr_forward, mngr_claude). Covers the required host setup (Claude Code trust for `~/.mngr/copies`, a skip-permissions `yolo` agent type), invocation gotchas (`MNGR_HEADLESS`, underscore-named output dirs), flaky-launch recovery, and post-run integration in the jj-colocated repo (rebase onto the reducer branch, changelog renaming, ruff format, re-running release witnesses locally).
